prompt_fragment:
This asset is UI chrome or ornamentation. Keep it decorative, controlled, and cleanly cuttable from the background.
Keep decorative edges controlled and production-friendly for UI extraction.
raw_description:
A horizontal cartographic scale bar — alternating filled and empty
segments with small tick marks beneath, labels reading "0  ·  1  ·  2  ·  3
hexes" in small-caps serif.

formatted_prompt.scene: Ink and watercolor horizontal cartographic scale bar on aged vellum cream parchment, alternating filled and hollow segments with fine nib-pen tick marks, ember orange and slate ink accents punctuating the ruled baseline.

subjects.description: Four alternating rectangular segments, filled and hollow, fine ruled edges with precise tick marks below, small-caps serif labels reading 0 · 1 · 2 · 3 hexes
subjects.position: centered horizontal, generous negative space above and below

subjects.description: Single continuous ink rule beneath segments, hairline weight, faint foxing and aged texture along the paper surface
subjects.position: bottom edge of scale bar, full width
